acceptedArguments.name: node-id
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Decimal PipeWire Audio/Source node ID.

acceptedArguments.name: source-name
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exact PipeWire source node.name matching node-id.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Changes the PipeWire/PulseAudio default input and moves active application source streams; rolls back on migration failure when possible.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after observing current state; the implementation validates the target and attempts rollback before reporting partial failure.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure for validation or rollback may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy validates exact PipeWire identity, hard-fails backend errors, and applies bounded rollback instead of the pinned helper's best-effort mutations.

acceptedArguments.name: node-id
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Decimal PipeWire Audio/Sink node ID.

acceptedArguments.name: sink-name
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exact PipeWire sink node.name matching node-id.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Changes the PipeWire/PulseAudio default output and moves active application sink streams; rolls back on migration failure when possible.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after observing current state; the implementation validates the target and attempts rollback before reporting partial failure.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure for validation or rollback may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy validates exact PipeWire identity, hard-fails backend errors, rolls back default/stream changes, and uses exit 2 for invalid arguments instead of the pinned helper's best-effort behavior.

acceptedArguments.name: sink-name
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Optional selected sink name; when omitted the current PulseAudio default sink is inspected.

capabilities.stdoutContract: Exactly one resolved sink name followed by a newline.
capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe; the result is recomputed from current audio graph state.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure for validation or rollback may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy bounds backend inspection and reports unresolved physical sinks as explicit domain failures.

capabilities.stdoutContract: One line per PipeWire sink: <node.name> TAB <availability>, where availability is 1 or 0.
capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe; the result is recomputed from current PipeWire graph state.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure for validation or rollback may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy derives availability from structured PipeWire node/port data instead of preserving the pinned helper's PulseAudio/tuning-helper implementation.

acceptedArguments.name: verbose
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Optional --verbose flag requests detailed interface, address, link, and bounded latency telemetry.

capabilities.stdoutContract: Without --verbose, one tab-separated disconnected, ethernet, or wifi status row. With --verbose, one tab-separated key/value record per line.
capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Verbose queries may send bounded ICMP probes to the active gateway and 1.1.1.1.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe; every result is recomputed from current network state.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure while deriving a domain result may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy uses locale-stable bounded backend calls and structured route/address inspection while preserving the shell-consumed status semantics.

acceptedArguments.name: interface
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Active Wi-Fi NetworkManager interface name.

capabilities.stdoutContract: Exactly the active non-enterprise Wi-Fi password followed by a newline.
capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; secrets are never written to stderr.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe; the secret is reread from the active NetworkManager connection.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure while deriving a domain result may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy rejects enterprise credentials and unsupported multiline secret data explicitly and bounds NetworkManager requests.

acceptedArguments.name: meta
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Optional --meta flag prepends interface, security type, and SSID metadata.

acceptedArguments.name: interface
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Optional active Wi-Fi interface; when omitted the active Wi-Fi connection is discovered.

capabilities.stdoutContract: Optional meta TAB interface TAB security TAB ssid row followed by a QR matrix encoded as lines of 0 and 1 characters.
capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; Wi-Fi credentials are never written to stderr.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe; connection data and QR output are regenerated from current NetworkManager state.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure while deriving a domain result may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy rejects enterprise Wi-Fi sharing, validates connection data, and bounds both NetworkManager and QR encoder calls.

capabilities.stdoutContract: Three tab-separated records: band, available, and selected, each followed by a newline.
capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe; current and available bands are recomputed from NetworkManager and wireless link state.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure while deriving a domain result may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy reports current, available, and selected band state explicitly using bounded locale-stable NetworkManager and wireless inspection.

acceptedArguments.name: band
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exactly one of auto, 2.4, 5, or 6.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; rollback and partial-failure diagnostics are written to stderr.
sideEffects: Changes the active NetworkManager connection's Wi-Fi band and reassociates it; restores the previous band when activation or verification fails when possible.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after rereading active profile and link state; the implementation verifies the requested band and attempts rollback before reporting failure.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure for activation, verification, or rollback may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy validates band availability before mutation and verifies post-association link state with bounded rollback on failure.

capabilities.stdoutContract: Exactly one provider name followed by a newline: DHCP, Cloudflare, Google, or Custom.
capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe; the provider is derived from current active NetworkManager connection state.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure while deriving a domain result may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy derives DNS ownership from the active NetworkManager profile instead of reading or mutating Omarchy-owned /etc policy files.

acceptedArguments.name: provider
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exactly one of DHCP, Cloudflare, or Google. Custom is intentionally not a portable mutation.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; rollback and partial-failure diagnostics are written to stderr.
sideEffects: Changes ipv4.ignore-auto-dns and ipv4.dns on the active NetworkManager connection and reactivates it; restores previous values when application or verification fails when possible.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after rereading the active profile; the implementation verifies the requested provider state and attempts rollback before reporting failure.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Each external backend call is bounded by Omanixy timed(); direct deadline expiration returns 124. A higher-level operation that catches a timed backend failure for activation, verification, or rollback may return domain failure 1 with a diagnostic.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy limits portable DNS mutation to DHCP, Cloudflare, and Google through NetworkManager; upstream Custom distribution-policy editing is intentionally excluded.

acceptedArguments.name: state
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exactly on or off for the frozen Quattro consumer.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Changes the persistent Bluetooth rfkill soft-block state; power-on waits for BlueZ controller state and falls back to an explicit adapter power-on request.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry is safe after rereading controller state; repeated on/off requests converge on the requested rfkill state.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Backend waits are bounded by Omanixy timed(), but bluetooth_power catches those backend statuses and reports a higher-level domain failure 1 when the requested power transition cannot be completed. The primitive timed() boundary itself normalizes timeout termination to 124.
intentionalDeviations: Only the frozen Quattro-reachable on/off subset is a semantic capability here; legacy toggle and is-on helper forms are not promoted into the public Host Contract.

acceptedArguments.name: action
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exactly pair.

acceptedArguments.name: address
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Bluetooth MAC address in XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX form.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Powers Bluetooth on if needed, pairs the device, marks it trusted, and requests a connection.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after observing BlueZ device state; pairing/trust/connect are asynchronous service mutations.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Pairing, trust, and connection calls are individually bounded. bluetooth_device intentionally collapses any timed backend failure into domain failure 1; timed() itself normalizes timeout termination to 124 before that collapse.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy validates MAC syntax, powers the adapter on before pairing, bounds each BlueZ call, and reports operation failure deterministically.

acceptedArguments.name: action
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exactly connect.

acceptedArguments.name: address
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Bluetooth MAC address in XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX form.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Powers Bluetooth on if needed, marks the device trusted, and requests a connection.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after observing BlueZ device state; trust/connect are asynchronous service mutations.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Trust and connection calls are individually bounded. bluetooth_device intentionally collapses any timed backend failure into domain failure 1; timed() itself normalizes timeout termination to 124 before that collapse.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy validates MAC syntax, powers the adapter on before connection, bounds each BlueZ call, and reports operation failure deterministically.

acceptedArguments.name: action
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exactly disconnect.

acceptedArguments.name: address
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Bluetooth MAC address in XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX form.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Requests disconnection of the selected BlueZ device.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after observing BlueZ device state; disconnect is an asynchronous service mutation.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: The disconnection call is bounded. bluetooth_device intentionally collapses a timed backend failure into domain failure 1; timed() itself normalizes timeout termination to 124 before that collapse.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy validates MAC syntax and bounds the BlueZ disconnect request instead of leaving backend failure best-effort.

acceptedArguments.name: action
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Exactly forget.

acceptedArguments.name: address
acceptedArguments.valueContract: Bluetooth MAC address in XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX form.

capabilities.stderrContract: Diagnostics only; no success data is written to stderr.
sideEffects: Powers Bluetooth on if needed, requests disconnection, and removes the selected device from BlueZ pairing state.
capabilities.retrySemantics: Retry only after observing BlueZ device state; removal may already have completed before a reported failure.
capabilities.deadlineSemantics: Disconnection and removal calls are individually bounded. bluetooth_device intentionally collapses any timed backend failure into domain failure 1; timed() itself normalizes timeout termination to 124 before that collapse.
intentionalDeviations: Omanixy validates MAC syntax, bounds disconnection/removal, and treats incomplete backend work as an explicit operation failure.
